evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking to identified content's organization; A is absent.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates) and separate presentation/organization metadata (origin) are both explicitly present and distinguished for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change statement linked to the organization/presentation/access of an identified content.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (coordinate sets) with named attributes (red/blue) are present.

D.rationale: The report separates identified content (red coordinates) from its status/ provenance (origin metadata) for the same referent.

O.rationale: Explicit organization/presentation metadata (origin/kind/represented_time) describe how contents are presented or derived for current referents.
